first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Blue Sky
entities.identification: A large blue area above the horizon, lighter near the horizon, whose position in the frame changes with the roll.

entities.name: Dry Grassland
entities.identification: An open, light yellowish-brown ground surface with clustered grass patches, gaps of bare soil, and rough light-and-dark textures.

entities.name: Scattered Trees and Shrubs
entities.identification: Greenish-brown clump-shaped shrubs and light-brown sparse trees distributed at intervals across the grassland, treated as an environmental vegetation group.

entities.name: Dirt Road and Linear Track
entities.identification: A light-brown band-shaped passage and adjacent elongated ground marks in the grassland, retaining the entity attribution from the original source.

entities.name: Distant Cluster of Low-Rise Buildings
entities.identification: Light-gray and off-white block-shaped building outlines near the distant horizon, with some blocks higher than adjacent outlines.

entities.name: Distant Long, Narrow Water Surface
entities.identification: A smooth blue-gray band of water on the far side of the grassland, varying in width and adjoining a light-colored shore.
